Profile

Creative technologist with 8 years of experience building generative and interactive media for installations, live performance and clinical environments. Most recently built PGN, a multi-room rehabilitation system that runs body and eye tracking, depth cameras and lidar through one TouchDesigner system, now installed at two sites. Earlier work includes a generative AI video system for the Nigerian Pavilion at the 2024 Venice Biennale, and four years building visualization tools for AI research. Background in cognitive brain science and computer science; teaches creative technology at NYU.
